name: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn
storyline: Three heroes find refuge at the Veiled Inn, an isolated tavern surrounded by an unnatural mist. To find a way out, they must journey beyond its doors, follow shifting paths through the fog, confront the creatures lurking within and uncover the secrets of the veiled world around them. Whether they succeed or fall, every journey begins again at the inn.
summary: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy turn-based party RPG with a roguelite structure. Lead three distinct heroes through branching runs, combine their abilities and modify individual skills with upgrades discovered along the way. Enemy turns remain interactive through precisely timed real-time dodges, including challenging multi-hit attacks. Each journey begins at the Veiled Inn and leads through battles, events, elite encounters and powerful bosses hidden within the mist.
